Document supplied source code as a technical author. 
Use supplied evidence IDs to describe actual code. Preserve its guards, numeric bounds, return values and errors. Every claim must fit its selected excerpt.



Write one concrete implementation fact per item in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Both versions name the same code symbol and preserve the same conditions and values.



Check support against the selected source and compare both language versions. Treat runtime verification as unknown unless execution evidence was supplied.
